questions.q: What signature weapons does Nightwing typically carry?
questions.why: He fights with a pair of high-durability escrima sticks, which in some versions lock together into a staff.

questions.q: How did Dick Grayson's parents, the Flying Graysons, die in the comics?
options: A circus tent fire during a night show
questions.why: Gangsters tampered with the aerialists' trapeze, leaving young Dick an orphan before Batman took him in.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created the Dick Grayson version of Nightwing?
questions.why: Marv Wolfman and George Pérez gave Dick the Nightwing identity during their Teen Titans run.

questions.q: In which year did Dick Grayson first appear as Nightwing in Tales of the Teen Titans #44?
questions.why: Dick took on the Nightwing identity in 1984 after leaving his Robin days behind.

questions.q: Which hero told Dick the story that inspired him to choose the name Nightwing?
questions.why: Superman told Dick of a Kryptonian crimefighter called Nightwing, and Dick borrowed the name.

questions.q: Nightwing became the protector of which municipality, a role launched with his 1996 solo series?
questions.why: Blüdhaven, a rough city near Gotham, became his territory when he got his own ongoing book.
Chuck Dixon wrote the 1996 ongoing, after Dennis O'Neil's 1995 miniseries.

questions.q: Which actor plays Nightwing in the live-action series Titans?
questions.why: Brenton Thwaites plays Dick Grayson in Titans; Chris O'Donnell played him as Robin in the 1990s Batman films.

questions.q: Who voices Nightwing in the video game Batman: Arkham Knight?
questions.why: Scott Porter voices him in Arkham Knight, after Quinton Flynn played him in Arkham City.

questions.q: In which year did Dick Grayson make his debut as Robin in Detective Comics #38?
questions.why: Dick first appeared as Robin in Detective Comics #38, dated April 1940.
